args.title: Accept quoted column names in CSV statement headers
args.body:
File: src/api/uploads.ts

The current statement upload rejects files when the header line has quoted column names, causing a "Malformed row" error at row 1. However, the transaction lines also have quoted fields, which are accepted.

This change proposes to modify the CSV parsing logic to handle quoted column names in the header correctly, allowing uploads with quoted header fields to be accepted as well. This matches the behavior that removing quotes from the header line enables the upload. This fix will improve compatibility with bank exports that quote header columns.
